citations.quote: Wohnwerk Thur's termination notice is attached, together with the first page of our lease.
My wife and I are married and this flat is our family home; we live here with our baby and my wife's teenage son.
In June we went to the conciliation authority because the landlord refused to repair the broken heating for weeks, and we won. The termination came three weeks later.
With a baby, finding something affordable in the area before the end of January is not realistic.
The lease is terminated with effect from: 31 January 2027

plan.because: The supplied first page omits the remaining agreed tenancy terms.
The supplied form does not identify an addressee; request the complete notice and any accompanying addressed pages.
The recipient and delivery date must be evidenced urgently to assess the challenge deadline.
The complete agreed notice period and relevant termination dates are not established.
The form states arrears but does not document their factual basis.
A family home is reported; obtain the separate spouse notice and service evidence if available.
The arrears branch is active; the cure period, claimed balance and termination warning need verification.
Amounts due, payment dates and any outstanding balance need verification.
The reported prior repair dispute and termination chronology warrant a retaliation screen, without assuming retaliation occurred.
Reported family and housing hardship makes extension evidence relevant.
This document type is optional under the process.

questions: On what date did each of you receive the termination notice, and what delivery evidence or envelopes are available? The challenge deadline needs urgent assessment.
Was a separate termination notice addressed and delivered to your wife? If so, when?
Did the landlord send a written payment deadline and termination warning before the notice? What was paid and when?
What housing searches have you undertaken, and what responses have you received?
